ننساب (form VII)
# نَنْسَابُ (nansābu) /nan.saː.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَابَ (insāba)
# نَنْسَابَ (nansāba) /nan.saː.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَابَ (insāba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
